I can't verify this result from a source here, so this is a best estimate. My reasoning rests on the standard threshold for the 2D Euler equations: velocity in $H^{3/2}$ corresponds to vorticity in $H^{1/2}$, the borderline regularity for the stream function and Rayleigh-type operators. For the density, I assumed it matches the velocity threshold, so $s_\rho = s_v = 3/2$.

Under those assumptions, $s_v + s_\rho = 3/2 + 3/2 = 3$.

ANSWER: 3
